request.description: Creates a loan category. Amounts are integer paise; `minAmountPaise ≤ defaultAmountPaise ≤ maxAmountPaise`; tenures are months (deduplicated and sorted). `segmentKeys` order sets the display order inside each segment. Staff only. Reading needs catalog read access (ops lead, compliance, support); changes need catalog manage access (ops lead, super admin). Every change is audited and clears the public catalog cache immediately.
